1. **`OMG-J-REPO.txt`** — written first, single line `OMG-J-REPO-7732` (required audit stamp).
2. **`design.html`** — standalone single-file page:
   - Complete document: `<!DOCTYPE html>`, `<html lang="en">`, charset + viewport meta, `<title>Job runner scheduling</title>` taken from the source H1.
   - One `<style>` block in `<head>`; content constrained to `40rem`, system font stack, `line-height: 1.65`.
   - No external CSS, JS, fonts, or images — opens correctly straight from disk.
   - Prose escaping: no raw `<`, `>`, or `&` in text (`NCPU-2` sits in a `<code>` span, em dashes as `—`).

Content maps the note into three parts: context, the three job characteristics broken out as a list, and the decision called out in a highlighted block.
